problem_statement: Avoid triggering property methods when inspecting plugin attribute signatures
patch:
diff --git a/src/pluggy/_manager.py b/src/pluggy/_manager.py
index 325388a88512c556fc4c1de137b31885dcd093c8..d7c019a9f7af208d11a9359f631f7541dfe0c9c0 100644
--- a/src/pluggy/_manager.py
+++ b/src/pluggy/_manager.py
@@ -169,6 +169,20 @@ class PluginManager:
         customize how hook implementation are picked up. By default, returns the
         options for items decorated with :class:`HookimplMarker`.
         """
+
+        # IMPORTANT: @property methods can have side effects, and are never hookimpl
+        # if attr is a property, skip it in advance
+        plugin_class = plugin if inspect.isclass(plugin) else type(plugin)
+        if isinstance(getattr(plugin_class, name, None), property):
+            return None
+
+        # pydantic model fields are like attrs and also can never be hookimpls
+        plugin_is_pydantic_obj = hasattr(plugin, "__pydantic_core_schema__")
+        if plugin_is_pydantic_obj and name in getattr(plugin, "model_fields", {}):
+            # pydantic models mess with the class and attr __signature__
+            # so inspect.isroutine(...) throws exceptions and cant be used
+            return None
+
         method: object = getattr(plugin, name)
         if not inspect.isroutine(method):
             return None
test_patch:
diff --git a/testing/test_pluginmanager.py b/testing/test_pluginmanager.py
index dd395950f7585f7a3c1da80f24114c7c75e2d443..1b9ecbd0201e50f5b99b2c4e4f914db89716eeb7 100644
--- a/testing/test_pluginmanager.py
+++ b/testing/test_pluginmanager.py
@@ -4,6 +4,8 @@
 
 import importlib.metadata
 from typing import Any
+from typing import Dict
+from typing import List
 from typing import cast
 
 import pytest
@@ -125,6 +127,36 @@ def test_set_blocked(pm: PluginManager) -> None:
     assert pm.register(A(), "somename")
 
 
+def test_register_skips_properties(he_pm: PluginManager) -> None:
+    class ClassWithProperties:
+        property_was_executed: bool = False
+
+        @property
+        def some_func(self):
+            self.property_was_executed = True
+            return None
+
+    test_plugin = ClassWithProperties()
+    he_pm.register(test_plugin)
+    assert not test_plugin.property_was_executed
+
+
+def test_register_skips_pydantic_fields(he_pm: PluginManager) -> None:
+    class PydanticModelClass:
+        # stub to make object look like a pydantic model
+        model_fields: Dict[str, bool] = {"some_attr": True}
+
+        def __pydantic_core_schema__(self): ...
+
+        @hookimpl
+        def some_attr(self): ...
+
+    test_plugin = PydanticModelClass()
+    he_pm.register(test_plugin)
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        he_pm.hook.some_attr.get_hookimpls()
+
+
 def test_register_mismatch_method(he_pm: PluginManager) -> None:
     class hello:
         @hookimpl

sample_rationale: §7.3：仓库 pytest-dev/pluggy 排序后候选序列中第 1 个通过 §6 三向自校验的候选
known_limits: F2P 全部/部分为**新增测试**（基线上不存在该 node）：4/4 条，符合 SWE-bench 的 FAIL_TO_PASS 语义
判定命令用实例 artifacts/ 下的临时 _eval_pytest.ini 替换仓库 pytest 配置（本机只有 pytest 9.1.1，仓库 ini 的旧选项在新版下 INTERNALERROR）；B/T/G 三观测点与三向自校验都用同一模板，因此实例内部自洽，但与仓库 tox 环境的逐字配置不同（§10.3 第 2 条）

本机 git 全局 core.autocrlf=true ⇒ 构造器的全部 git 调用钉死 -c core.autocrlf=false，否则补丁正文（LF）与工作树（CRLF）不匹配、git apply 失败 ; §9.1 的 git status --porcelain 为空判据不含被仓库 .gitignore 忽略的构建产物（pip install -e . 留下的 egg-info / __pycache__）——这些是 R4/R7 装依赖的必要结果 ; §9.1 的「跑后 porcelain 为空」按**未跟踪且未被忽略的文件**判定：施加补丁造成的已跟踪文件修改不算垃圾（补丁本身是判据的一部分）；基线检出时仍要求完全为空
